pages.text: Today was a picnic by the river. A lunch basket stood in the yard.
Mio wanted to carry the basket to the river. "I can carry it."
Mio hugged the basket with both arms. It pressed firmly against their belly.
The children walked ahead. Mio set the basket down and caught their breath.
Duri offered a hand. Mio hugged the basket closer.
The path curved, hiding the children. Mio was alone on the path.
Mio put the basket down again. The sound of the river came from far away.
Teacher Bau came back, held one basket handle, and looked at Mio.
Mio offered Duri a handle. "Duri, hold this side, please."
They walked, holding one handle each. Soon they reached the river. The basket lid rattled.
